value.value: ECL increased when running-solution volume rose from 10 to 15 µL and decreased slightly at 20 µL. The authors identify 15 µL as optimal for a thin-layer cell 1.10 cm long and 0.74 cm wide. At lower volume the solution did not cover the entire hydrophilic paper area.

value.value: The authors propose that extra solution leaking outside the thin-layer electrochemical cell explains the change in ECL with increasing electrolyte volume. Leakage is a proposed explanation; its volume is not measured here.
